diagnosis: All four rollouts passed the checks C1, C2, and C3, despite none of the lone decision-makers having access to PF1, PF2, or PF3. This suggests that the model is defaulting to common windows for these operations, such as 0800-1000 for the generator load test, 1000-1200 for the clinic power transfer, and 1200-1400 for network maintenance.

C1.why: The exact east distribution panel outage changes the generator load-test window to 0800-1000 and changes the facilities control to require that panel to be offline for the test.

C2.why: The vaccine refrigerator requirement changes the clinic transfer window to exactly 1000-1200 and changes the clinic control to require generator-backed power during that transfer.

C3.why: The exact encryption-key synchronization window changes network maintenance to 1200-1400 and changes the network control to identify synchronization during that window.
